selection: Training tune rows only. Sequentially fit unigram on Unigram cases; bigram with that unigram fixed on Bigram cases; neural on Neural cases with count fallback fixed. Top1 then top4; smaller weight on ties.
audit: Freeze all choices before writer/document-disjoint training audit. Audit never chooses weights. No test_datas.npy, LM validation/test, or unique-181 read.
right_context: Observed suffix after the omitted target only, capped at two tokens. No target leakage.
unused_mode_policy: Retain the supplied baseline coefficient when a mode has no fitting cases; never optimize an empty subset
